meta.title: Who really said "She Is Too Fond of Books, and It Has Turned Her Brain"? | Quotle.info
meta.description: Alcott wrote the sentence in chapter 2 of Work: A Story of Experience (1873). Liz Smith later quoted it with credit to Alcott; she was not its author.
